profiles.purpose: Local simulator/device development against the Next.js dev server.

profiles.command: npm run mobile:cap:doctor && npm run mobile:cap:sync
profiles.purpose: Prepare signed builds for product-team QA.
Open Xcode to archive and upload an iOS build to TestFlight.
Create an Android App Bundle for Play Console internal testing.

profiles.command: npm run check:release && npm run mobile:cap:sync
profiles.purpose: Final store-submission gate after release checks pass.

signingNotes: Apple signing certificates and provisioning profiles are intentionally not committed.
Android upload keys and keystore passwords are intentionally not committed.
Production builds must use company-owned Apple Developer and Google Play Console accounts.
